findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_form_changes, search_alerts · Private data: get_processing_time, get_visa_bulletin, get_visa_bulletin_dv, get_visa_bulletin_notes · Public sink: get_visa_bulletin_notes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_form_changes, search_alerts · Private data: get_processing_time, get_visa_bulletin, get_visa_bulletin_dv, get_visa_bulletin_notes · Public sink: get_visa_bulletin_notes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
